Statements: Some accounts are cheques. All cheques are lockers. No lockers is a cards.
Conclusions:
I. Some accounts are lockers.
II. Some cheques are cards.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only I follows. The stated A–B overlap lies in C. Since B is contained in C, no B can be D.

questions.stem:
Statements: Only a few accounts are cheques. Some cheques are lockers. All lockers are cards.
Conclusions:
I. All accounts are cards.
II. No cheques is a cards.
questions.explanation: Answer: Neither I nor II follows. A need not be contained in D. Some B are C and therefore D, contradicting II.

questions.stem:
Statements: Only a few accounts are cheques. All cheques are lockers. No lockers is a cards.
Conclusions:
I. Some accounts are not cheques.
II. No cheques is a cards.
questions.explanation: Answer: Both I and II follow. Only a few means some are and some are not. All B are C and no C is D excludes every B from D.

questions.stem:

Conclusions:
I. All accounts are cards.
II. Some cards are cheques.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only II follows. The B–C overlap is inside D, proving II. No universal A–D relation is given.

questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
rural growth access = ni su vo
rural banking credit = su mi re
growth banking digital = lu ni mi
access credit digital = vo lu re
rural growth digital = lu ni su
What is the code for “rural”?
questions.explanation: Answer: su. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: rural = su, growth = ni, access = vo, banking = mi, credit = re, digital = lu.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 40 km east, turns left and walks 44 km, then turns left and walks 7 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 55. Net displacement is 33 km east and 44 km north. By Pythagoras, √(33² + 44²) = 55 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 36 km east, turns left and walks 32 km, then turns left and walks 12 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 40. Net displacement is 24 km east and 32 km north. By Pythagoras, √(24² + 32²) = 40 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 50 km east, turns left and walks 60 km, then turns left and walks 5 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 75. Net displacement is 45 km east and 60 km north. By Pythagoras, √(45² + 60²) = 75 km.

questions.stem: D is the mother of F. C is the son of F. H is the father of F. How is C related to H?
questions.explanation: Answer: Grandson. H is a parent of F, and C is F’s son. Hence C is H’s grandchild.

questions.stem: A is the brother of E. E is the mother of H. C is the father of A and E. How is A related to H?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. A is the brother of H’s mother E. Therefore A is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: E is the only daughter of D. D is the father of E. B is the son of E. H is the sister of D. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. D is the father of E, and E is B’s mother. Thus D is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 52 candidates, a candidate is 20th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 30. New front rank = 20+3 = 23. Back rank = 52 − 23 + 1 = 30.

questions.stem: In a queue of 48 candidates, a candidate is 22th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 23. New front rank = 22+4 = 26. Back rank = 48 − 26 + 1 = 23.

II. y² − 3y + 2 = 0
Choose the strongest relationship that holds for all possible root pairings.
options: x = y or relationship cannot be determined
questions.explanation: Answer: x > y. Factor I: roots 4, 14. Factor II: roots 1, 2. Compare all four pairings to obtain x > y.

questions.stem: An item costs ₹1000. It is marked above cost and sold at a 25% discount on marked price, earning 20% profit. Find the marked price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 1600. Selling price = 1000 × 120/100. Marked price = selling price ÷ 0.75 = 1600.

questions.stem: A can finish a job in 26 days and B in 39 days. They work together for 4 days, then B leaves. How many more days does A need? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 19.33. Use 78 work units. Rates: A = 3, B = 2 units/day. Remaining = 78 − 4×5. Divide by A’s rate 3.

questions.stem: A boat travels 285 km downstream and the same distance upstream. Its still-water speed is 17 km/h and stream speed is 2 km/h. Find the total time (hours).
A invests ₹38000 for 12 months. B invests ₹76000 for 8 months. Total profit is ₹100800. Find B’s share (₹).
questions.explanation: Answer: 57600. Capital-time ratio = 12 : 16. B’s share = total × 16/(28) = 57600.

questions.stem: What is the difference (₹) between compound interest and simple interest on ₹11000 at 15% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 247.5. For 2 years, CI − SI = P(r/100)² = 11000 × (15/100)².

questions.stem: A vessel contains 60 litres of milk and water in ratio 3:2. How many litres of pure milk must be added to make the ratio 2:1?
questions.explanation: Answer: 12. Milk = 3V/5, water = 2V/5. Solve (3V/5 + x)/(2V/5) = 2; x = V/5 = 12.

questions.stem: The average of 34 numbers is 46. One number, 58, is replaced and the average rises by 5. What is the new number?
questions.explanation: Answer: 228. Total increases by 34 × 5. New number = 58 + 170.

questions.stem: A father is three times as old as his daughter. After 8 years, their combined age will be 100 years. Find the father’s present age.
questions.explanation: Answer: 63. Let daughter’s age be x. Father is 3x. 4x + 16 = 100; x = 21, so father = 63.

questions.stem: A train of length 150 m crosses a 160 m platform at 54 km/h. Find crossing time in seconds (to two decimals).
A village has 4400 registered customers. This increases by 10% in year 1 and decreases by 30% in year 2. What is the final number?
questions.explanation: Answer: 3388. Apply successive factors: 4400 × 110/100 × 70/100.
